slot.brief: Statements with one negative or particular statement (Some A are not B type); conclusions include one definite deduction and one 'possibility' conclusion; ask which conclusions follow.

stem:
**Statements:**
All limes are citrus fruits.
Some fruits are not citrus fruits.

**Conclusions:**
I. Some fruits are not limes.
II. Some citrus fruits may be limes.

verdicts.working: Since all limes are citrus, the stated non-citrus fruits are not limes, so I follows. The statements do not rule out some citrus fruits being limes, so II is possible and follows.

working:
The fruits that are not citrus cannot be limes, so I follows. Limes can be included within citrus fruits without contradiction, so II is possible.

Independent check: Since all limes are citrus, the stated non-citrus fruits are not limes, so I follows. The statements do not rule out some citrus fruits being limes, so II is possible and follows.
solution: Since all limes are citrus fruits, any fruit that is not a citrus fruit cannot be a lime; hence some fruits are not limes. The statements also allow some citrus fruits to be limes, so both conclusions follow.
